description: This file defines the XML mode for CodeMirror, a code editor component, including configuration for HTML and XML modes, tokenization, indentation, and MIME type definitions.

methods.name: inText
methods.description: Tokenizes text content, handling tags, entities, and CDATA sections.

methods.name: inTag
methods.description: Tokenizes inside an XML/HTML tag, handling attributes and tag closures.

methods.name: inAttribute
methods.description: Handles tokenization of attribute values, including quoted strings.

methods.name: inBlock
methods.description: Handles tokenization of CDATA and comment blocks.

methods.name: baseState
methods.description: Manages the parser state transitions for tags.

methods.name: closeTagNameState
methods.description: Handles parsing of closing tag names.

methods.name: attrEqState
methods.description: Handles parsing of attribute equal signs.

methods.name: attrContinuedState
methods.description: Handles continued parsing of attribute values.
